tool_calls.name: run_sql
tool_calls.arguments:
{"sql":"-- Count number of distinct playlists per track and find the maximum
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT pt.TrackId, t.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.PlaylistId) AS playlist_count
  FROM PlaylistTrack pt
  JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = pt.TrackId
  GROUP BY pt.TrackId
)
SELECT TrackId, Name, playlist_count
FROM counts
WHERE playlist_count = (SELECT MAX(playlist_count) FROM counts)
ORDER BY TrackId;
"}
